title: Witch Coven with Dragon
description: Three blonde women dressed as seductive witches in ornate black and blue corsets stand on a stone platform surrounded by lit black candles. A large purple and gold dragon coils around them, its head visible on the right while blue magical smoke rises from a staff held by the central figure.
prompt: Three beautiful blonde witches wearing elaborate black and blue corsets, fishnet stockings and dark gowns stand on a stone platform at night. One holds a glowing staff emitting blue smoke. A massive purple dragon with golden scales is coiled around the scene. Lit black candles with melted wax are placed on the ground. Dark purple starry sky background, mystical and atmospheric fantasy scene.
